about_the_game:
The Sword’s Awakening is an action-packed open-world RPG where you control an awakened sword using your mouse cursor. Slash, dodge, and battle through waves of enemies in this dynamic and evolving adventure. As you explore vast lands and uncover hidden secrets, you’ll grow stronger by gaining new abilities, upgrading your sword, and crafting unique builds. With elements of bullet-hell combat and RPG progression, every battle is intense, and every victory brings you closer to becoming an unstoppable force.

Embark on a journey filled with fierce enemies, secret locations, and increasingly difficult challenges. The world is vast, and the adventure is yours to define. Will you uncover the truth behind the sword’s awakening, or will you fall to the countless dangers that lie ahead?

Key Features:

  • Awakened Sword Control: Use your mouse cursor to control a sentient sword, slashing through enemies in fluid, fast-paced combat inspired by Fruit Ninja-style mechanics.
  • Bullet-Hell Combat: Engage in intense, dodge-heavy battles against swarms of enemies and powerful bosses, all while using quick reflexes to stay alive.
  • Explore a Vast World: Journey through a massive open world full of hidden paths, secret locations, and mysterious areas waiting to be discovered.
  • RPG Progression: Level up your sword and character, gain new abilities, and choose unique upgrades to tailor your playstyle and combat strategies.
  • Craft Your Unique Build: Combine various abilities and upgrades to create powerful and personalized builds, allowing you to customize your combat style.
  • Dynamic Enemies & Bosses: Face a wide variety of enemies, each with their own attacks and strategies. Boss battles will challenge your skill and reflexes, rewarding you with powerful upgrades.
  • Hunter's Diary: Collect and catalog every enemy you defeat in your Hunter’s Diary. Like a Pokedex for monsters, track your progress, learn about enemy behavior, and complete your collection of foes to unlock rewards and hidden secrets.
  • Unlock New Abilities & Skills: Progress through the game to unlock new powers, expanding your combat options and allowing for even more creative ways to defeat enemies.
  • Endless Replayability: With new areas to discover, abilities to master, and strategies to test, The Sword's Awakening offers endless replay value.
